sizing.notes:
Multi-container stack (api + worker + beat + frontend + space +
MinIO + Postgres + Redis). Heavy idle RAM; budget 1 GB
headroom over the rest of the suite.

1 Go au-dessus du reste de la suite.

en.summary: Project management with issues, cycles and modules.
en.what_it_is: Open-source project management -- issues, cycles, modules, pages, workspaces.
en.compose_description: Open-source project management. Replaces Jira / Linear / Asana.
en.setup_steps:
1. Press **Deploy application**. Wait ~2-3 min (several services, MinIO included); the **Logs** section shows the progress.
2. Visit the Plane domain and sign up to create the instance admin + first workspace. Plane keeps its own login: single sign-on is in its paid editions only.

fr.summary: Gestion de projet avec tâches, cycles et modules.
fr.what_it_is: Gestion de projet open-source -- issues, cycles, modules, pages, workspaces.
fr.compose_description: Gestion de projet open-source. Remplace Jira / Linear / Asana.
fr.setup_steps:
1. Appuyez sur **Déployer l'application**. Patientez ~2-3 min (plusieurs services, MinIO compris) ; la section **Journaux** montre la progression.
2. Visitez le domaine Plane et créez le compte admin initial + le premier workspace. Plane garde sa propre connexion : l'authentification unique n'existe que dans ses éditions payantes.
